cells.gaps: No delivery plan and no report against the policy has been found, and nothing on a mandated body or a budget line within the 36 months. The policy document is undated: 2007 is the record's published date, and the 2026 World Bank report that treats it as in force gives no adoption date or scope.
cells.note: National ICT Policy 2007: adopted, its text public on the regulator's site and its period open, with no successor recorded. An open policy stops at stage 3, and no delivery plan or results report has been found for stage 4.
